$comment: Every event type in platform.events: who must publish it and who must handle it, and the workstream that owes it. tools/lint/test/events.test.ts fails when a service in services/ does not declare (src/events.ts) an event it owes, or publishes one not listed here. Payloads carry ids, flags, hashes and staff-curated catalogue labels only.

user.created.payload: user_id, role, university_id, provider, visibility, onboarding defaults, status, agreement_accepted

user.deleted.payload: user_id; every service removes the user's rows and publishes user.deletion_confirmed

user.deletion_confirmed.payload: user_id; producer role identifies the service

user.tokens_revoked.payload: tv, reason; read by every service's token verifier (platform revocation cache), not a consumer

audit.recorded.payload: audit_id, action, target_type, target_id; trust builds the /ops audit view (W10)

university.domains_changed.payload: university_id, live_at, domains [{domain, kind}]; notify sends launch emails when live_at is set (W9)

profile.gate_changed.payload: user_id, has_profile, role, university_id, onboarding_complete, onboarding_step, status

profile.updated.payload: ids, enums and flags of the profile (no names, no city); department_hash (sha256 of the department text, W3)

profile.image_replaced.payload: user_id, which image; media deletes the old file (W9)

onboarding.advanced.payload: user_id, step; trust forwards to analytics (W10)

tour.ended.payload: user_id, tour, how; trust forwards to analytics (W10)

badge.count_changed.payload: user_id, key, count (absolute); keys allow-listed per producer in services/people/src/store/copies.ts

fact.value_changed.payload: user_id, key, value (schema per key in people)

skill.changed.payload: user_id, skill_id, skill_label (catalogue), level; category (catalogue, W6: ranking span bonus)

group.member_changed.payload: kind, group_id, user_id, member, role (member | officer | president; optional, societies), actor_id (optional) (ids only); notify's member left/removed notices (W9)

post.created.payload: post_id, author_id, type, audience, university_id, society_id, venture_id (W3); notify tells society followers (W9), trust forwards analytics (W10)

post.removed.payload: post_id, author_id, reason (deleted | removed | account_deleted), media_paths; media deletes the files (W9)

comment.created.payload: comment_id, post_id, author_id, post_author_id, parent_author_id, mentioned_ids; notify reads the excerpt back through content (W9)

survey.answered.payload: post_id, user_id, dimension, answer (analytics, W10); weight (the answer weight, W6: ranking quality index)

venture.updated.payload: venture_id, owner_id, university_id, status, visibility; previous_owner_id, previous_status, actor_id when they apply (W5): content's invite checks, messaging's team chat and pins, notify's ownership and closing notices (W9), trust's analytics (W10)

venture.completed.payload: venture_id, owner_id, university_id, visibility, member_ids (W5): content's Shipped post, ranking facts, a Record entry, notify's completed and endorse-your-teammates notices; completion {completed_at, team_size, weeks, skill_tags, deliverables, verified_members, members [{user_id, github_days, verified_entries, unconfirmed_entries}]}, frozen at completion (W6: ranking scores Work from it)

society.status_changed.payload: society_id, university_id, status (pending | more_info | verified | rejected | suspended), previous_status, verified_at, requester_id, actor_id (W7): posting as a verified society (content), the Record hold (ranking reads verified_at), society_decided (notify), analytics (trust)

university_seat.changed.payload: user_id, university_id, role (null when the seat ends) (W11): announcement reach, university hides

entitlement.changed.payload: subject_id, key, value (null or false when it ends) (W12); every service that gates a paid action copies it

config.changed.payload: key, version, value (W10); content keeps feed.* and survey.*; ranking keeps ranking.formula, feed.score and teacher.limits (W6)

post.reports_changed.payload: post_id, reports (open reports, absolute) (W10): the held stage

message.sent.payload: message_id, thread_id, sender_id, recipient_ids (not muted, not blocked) (W4); notify's chat notice and push (W9), trust's analytics (W10). Live delivery is realtime's NOTIFY, not this event

message.deleted.payload: message_ids, thread_id, sender_id, media_paths, undone_share (W4); notify takes back the chat notices of an undone share (W9), media deletes the files (W9)

thread.read.payload: thread_id, user_id (W4); notify marks the thread's chat notices read (W9)

conversation.allowed.payload: user_a, user_b, reason (application | swap), allowed (W5): DMs an accepted application or a skill swap opens

application.changed.payload: application_id, venture_id, candidate_id, owner_id, status (pending | accepted | declined | withdrawn | closed), previous_status (W5): notify's application notices (W9), trust's analytics (W10)

venture.invite_changed.payload: invite_id, venture_id, invitee_id, inviter_id, status (pending | accepted | declined | revoked), previous_status (W5): notify's invite notices; a revoked invite takes back its unread notice (W9)

endorsement.given.payload: endorsement_ids, endorser_id, endorsee_id, venture_id, skill_ids (W5): ranking facts (W6), notify's endorsement notice (W9)

endorsement.hidden.payload: endorsement_id, endorsee_id, hidden (W5): ranking stops or resumes counting it (W6)

credential.changed.payload: credential_id, user_id, status (approved | rejected | expired | deleted | file_removed), file_path when the file can go (W5): notify's review and expiry notices, media deletes the file (W9), ranking (W6); expires_on, recognised, created_at with every status but deleted (W6)

code_check.changed.payload: check_id, user_id, skill_id, status (W5): notify's ready, graded and expired notices (W9)

task.completed.payload: user_id, attempt_id, skill_id, skill_label and task_title (catalogue text), verified_by (W5): the Record entry (W8), notify (W9), analytics (W10)

task_review.changed.payload: review_id, attempt_id, reviewer_id, student_id, status (offered | needs_changes) (W5): notify (W9)

swap.changed.payload: swap_id, teacher_id, learner_id, skill_id, status, actor_id, session_id or note_id when they apply (W5): notify's swap notices and reminders (W9)

swap.closed.payload: swap_id, teacher_id, learner_id, skill_id, sessions, minutes, last_session_on (W5): the teacher's Taught entry (W8)

swap.flagged.payload: kind (swap_repeat | swap_ring), members, swap_ids or window_days (W5): ranking's anti-gaming flags, deduplicated there (W6)

contribution.logged.payload: contribution_id, venture_id, user_id, source (manual | github), before_venture, corrects_id, created_at (W5 for W6): ranking verified entries, consistency, decay

contribution.confirmed.payload: contribution_id, confirmer_id, confirmed_at (W5 for W6): ranking verified entries, citizenship

pull_request.recorded.payload: user_id, repo_id, number, repo (owner/name), merged_at, counted (W5 for W6): ranking Work and consistency

tier.changed.payload: user_id, tier (or null), ranked, previous_tier (W6): work keeps paths seniors (work.ranking_tiers), notify a tier-up notice (W9), trust analytics (W10)

ranking_flag.changed.payload: flag_id, kind (ring | rapid_gain | swap_ring | swap_repeat), members, status (open | cleared | upheld) (W6): work peer-review check leaves out open and upheld ring and swap flags

record.sealed.payload: entry_id, user_id, kind, issuer_type, issuer_id, occurred_on, signed_at, evidence {role, place, entrants, minutes} (W8): ranking Record component (W6), notify a new-entry notice (W9)

record.revoked.payload: entry_id, status (revoked | superseded) (W8): ranking drops it (W6), notify the revocation notice (W9)

case.resolved.payload: case_id, owner_id, severity (low | medium | high, or null when dismissed), staff_id, resolved_at (W10): ranking penalties for 12 months (W6)

case.overturned.payload: case_id (W10): an appeal overturned the decision; ranking removes its penalty (W6)

society.verified.payload: society_id, university_id, category, verified_at, requester_id (W7): the society_verified analytics event (W10)

society.invite_changed.payload: invite_id, society_id, kind (officer | handover), invitee_id, invited_by, status (pending | accepted | declined | withdrawn) (W7): society_invite and society_invite_answered notices (W9)

society.join_changed.payload: society_id, user_id, status (requested | accepted), actor_id (W7): society_join_request to the officers, society_joined to the student (W9)

society.term_changed.payload: term_id, society_id, user_id, role (president | officer), status (ended | confirmed), term_start, term_end, confirmed_by, self_confirmed (W7): the Office bearer Record entry on confirmed (W8; its line is the term title, read back with SocietyTerms when built), term_ended to the confirming officers (W9)

induction.changed.payload: round_id, society_id, university_id, status (draft | open | closed), deadline, actor_id (W7): induction_published to followers and members (W9), Openings (W11)

induction_application.changed.payload: application_id, round_id, society_id, applicant_id, status (pending | shortlisted | accepted | declined), expired, actor_id (W7): induction_applied and induction_decided notices (W9)

event.updated.payload: event_id, society_id, university_id, status (draft | published | live | ended | cancelled), previous_status, change (published | details | cancelled | status), starts_at, paid, actor_id (W7): event_published, event_changed and event_cancelled notices (W9), analytics (W10), Openings (W11)

event.registered.payload: registration_id, event_id, society_id, user_id, status (confirmed | held | pending | waitlisted | cancelled | declined), previous_status, waitlist_position, reason (registered | promoted | decided | cancelled | hold_expired | walk_in), paid, actor_id (W7): event_registration, event_promoted, event_decided and hold_expired notices (W9), analytics (W10)

ticket.checked_in.payload: checkin_id, event_id, session_id, user_id (null for a walk-in by email), method (scan | search | email | self | manual | walk_in), present (W7): analytics (W10)

event.closed.payload: event_id, society_id, university_id, society_verified, auto, issued_by, ends_on (PKT date), sessions, hours, team_event, record_kinds; attended [{user_id, first_at, self_added}], completed [{user_id, sessions, self_added}], results [{user_id, place, entrants, set_by_self, labelled}], volunteer [{user_id, minutes, self_logged}], walk_ins [{attendee_id, email_hash, first_at}] (W7): the Record entries (W8; role, place, entrants and minutes are the evidence ranking reads from record.sealed; a result label and walk-in addresses are read back from community when W8 is built)

event.cohost_changed.payload: event_id, society_id, host_society_id, status (pending | accepted | declined), actor_id (W7): event_cohost to the co-host officers (W9)

event.message_sent.payload: message_id, event_id, sender_id, recipients (W7): event_message to registrants; the body is read back from community (W9)

payment.changed.payload: payment_id, registration_id, event_id, society_id, user_id, status (awaiting | under_review | approved | rejected | released), refund_status, change (submitted | issue | approved | rejected | refund_requested | refund_sent | refund_received | refund_disputed | released), actor_id (W7): payment_review, payment_decided, refund_* notices (W9)

payment_method.changed.payload: method_id, society_id, action (add | replace | remove), status (proposed | active | rejected | ended), actor_id (W7): payment_details_proposed and payment_details_confirmed to the officers (W9)

payment.disputed.payload: payment_id, registration_id, event_id, society_id, user_id, president_id, reason (unconfirmed_payment | refund_disputed | refund_unmarked) (W7): trust opens a report case on the registration (W10)

community_file.released.payload: bucket (society-documents | society-media | event-receipts), path, owner_id (W7): a replaced or expired file media deletes (W9)
